name: @epoch/contract-conformance
description: W032 Contract conformance suite: a generated-per-surface conformance runner over every published manifest-bearing contract tree under contracts/ (actions, actualization, agent, execution, experience, experience-compiler, procurement, renderers, solution-delivery). Per tree: byte-identity drift (the committed JSON Schemas equal the owning package's render*ContractFiles() emission), manifest sha256 integrity, contract/protocol VERSION PINNING against the packages' exported constants, and zod round-trip parity (z.toJSONSchema of the live schema surface equals the committed schema document) — catching cross-domain drift between packs, kernels and contracts (named contract-drift tests per tree). NOT a pnpm workspace importer: tests/contracts sits outside the pnpm-workspace.yaml globs (owned surface, root manifests frozen), so this manifest DECLARES the frozen devDependency policy while import resolution happens via vitest resolve.alias + tsconfig paths. Run via: pnpm --filter @epoch/pack-construction exec vitest run --root ../../tests/contracts.
